meta.name: agent-memory
meta.description: Use when a project's CLAUDE.md has grown past what anyone reads and you want the agent to learn durable facts from its own sessions instead — or when asking why the agent keeps re-learning the same correction, why a remembered rule is wrong, or where a memory line came from. Implements a four-tier store (L0 transcripts / L1 candidates / L2 project context / L3 stable persona) where promotion is earned by recurrence across sessions and days, never by one confident statement, and nothing reaches a committed file without a human adopting it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把智能体的会话经验固化为持久记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果项目说明文件越来越长,智能体却还在重复犯错。
copy.tagline_en: Turn agent conversation history into durable long-term memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your CLAUDE.md is huge but your agent still repeats mistakes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会从会话中截取像指令、纠正、偏好这样的片段,先存为候选;同一内容要在不同日子、多轮会话里反复出现才会逐级晋升为长期记忆,写入前要你确认,并附上出处。
howto.when: 当项目 CLAUDE.md 太长没人读、你想让 Claude 改从自己的会话记住持久事实时;或你追问它为何反复学同一纠错、某条记忆为何是错的、某行记忆出自哪里时。装好后,会话开始、提问、结束都会自动运行。

say.text: 『PR base branch is dev』这条记忆是从哪来的?
say.note: 会显示来源会话、日期和引文。

say.text: 现在有哪些候选记忆?是什么在阻止它们升级?
say.note: 列出候选清单,并说明卡在哪一步。

say.text: 列出所有互相矛盾、还没解决的记忆。
say.note: 方便你人工裁决,谁也不会被悄悄覆盖。

howto.what_en: Claude captures notable moments from sessions as candidates. A fact advances through memory tiers only by recurring across sessions and days; nothing reaches your files until you adopt it; every line cites its source transcript.
howto.when_en: Use when CLAUDE.md is unreadable and you'd rather Claude learn from sessions; or when asking why it re-learns a correction, why a remembered rule is wrong, or where a memory line came from.

say_en.text: Where did the memory 'PR base branch is dev' come from?
say_en.note: Shows source sessions, dates, and quote.

say_en.text: What candidate memories are there, and what is blocking their promotion?
say_en.note: Lists the candidate queue and what blocks it.

say_en.text: List all memories that are still mutually contradictory.
say_en.note: For you to arbitrate; no side gets silently overwritten.
